verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk-operation capability, such as bulk triage, a multi-select action, or a batch-update endpoint. The CLI's scriptability and JSON output (e.g. `signals update <signal-id>`, which acts on one signal at a time) are building blocks a user could loop over, not a bulk feature. Signal backfill and failure clustering are adjacent automated analyses, not user-driven operations on many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
